concerns.text: The plan states that Open Babel will generate MACCS, **ECFP4**, and FP2 fingerprints via a CLI subprocess. Open Babel does not support ECF4/ECFP4 fingerprint generation; this functionality is provided by RDKit. As written, the pipeline will fail when attempting to produce ECFP4 fingerprints, violating the compute‑feasibility constraint. Replace the ECFP4 generation step with an RDKit‑based implementation (or drop ECFP4) to make the pipeline runnable on the 2‑core, 7 GB runner.
